title: United will not let an outside agent book the flight.
friendlyTitle: United will not let an outside helper book the flight.
summary: United's help page says it is restricting unauthorized third-party AI agents from its site and from travel agencies. That includes booking, changing, canceling, checking in, and opening a MileagePlus account, even if you gave the agent permission. Bookings an agent made before 11 November 2026 will not be canceled.
friendlySummary: United's help page says it is blocking outside AI helpers that it has not approved, on its own site and through travel agencies. That includes booking, changing, canceling, checking in, and opening a loyalty account, even if you told the helper it could. Trips a helper booked before 11 November 2026 will not be canceled.
whyItMatters: United says to use an agent for general trip ideas, not for a confirmation number, password, or loyalty login. If you already shared a login, change the password and review recent trips. Assistive tools for a disability can continue if they are not otherwise prohibited.
friendlyWhyItMatters: United says you can ask a helper for general trip ideas. Do not give it a confirmation number, a password, or a loyalty login. If you already did, change the password and check recent trips. Tools that help a person with a disability can still be used, if they are not otherwise banned.
